==New Haven==

{{i|Wild Turkey Wing}} requires baking a {{i|Raw Wild Turkey Wing}} for 2.5 hours in {{i|Any Stove}}.

==Providence==

2x {{i|Wild Turkey Wing}}s are received when Cutting Up a {{i|Stuffed Wild Turkey}}. Additionally a Wild Turkey Wing can be obtained by baking a {{i|Raw Turkey Wing}} in {{i|Any Stove}}.

==[https://forum.salemthegame.com/viewtopic.php?f=2&t=21020 Patch 2.3.0 - Quiet Before the Storm]==
As a part of the Gluttony overhaul, the poultry food group has been completely revamped.
